svg.aria-label: Hamstrings: origins and insertions — 腘绳肌：起点与止点

text.aria-label: Hamstrings: origins and insertions — 腘绳肌：起点与止点
Origin → insertion — 起点 → 止点
Origin: ischial tuberosity (long head) — 起点：坐骨结节（长头）
Insertion: head of fibula — 止点：腓骨头
Origin: ischial tuberosity — 起点：坐骨结节
Insertion: pes anserinus — 止点：鹅足
Origin: ischial tuberosity (upper lateral) — 起点：坐骨结节上外侧
Insertion: posterior medial tibial condyle — 止点：胫骨内侧髁后面

text.tspan: Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
